portability_contract.claim_boundary: A registered provider or listed target does not prove Supertonic executed there.

delivery_contract.streaming: The stream endpoint emits bounded chunks only after complete local ONNX synthesis and optional cleanup. It is not incremental model inference.

tools.name: nastech_plan_speech
tools.description: Compile English NastechML into an auditable local execution plan without generating audio.

tools.name: nastech_compile_speech
tools.description: Compile English NastechML into a local Supertonic expression prompt.

tools.name: nastech_generate_speech
tools.description: Generate completed local English expressive WAV audio with Supertonic ONNX.

tools.name: nastech_stream_speech
tools.description: Transfer a completed local WAV in bounded post-synthesis chunks; not incremental inference.

tools.name: nastech_clean_wav
tools.description: Apply deterministic local PCM hygiene to mono signed-16-bit WAV audio.

tools.name: nastech_list_platforms
tools.description: Report host facts, registered ONNX providers, and verified/planned portability profiles.

tools.name: nastech_platform_preflight
tools.description: Build a CPU, GPU, mobile, or browser activation plan with evidence requirements.

tools.name: nastech_runtime_diagnostics
tools.description: Read local CPU policy, model state, cache state, and runtime metrics.

tools.name: nastech_warmup_runtime
tools.description: Load the local ONNX runtime and perform a short warm-up synthesis.

tools.name: nastech_clear_runtime_cache
tools.description: Discard cached WAV responses without unloading local ONNX sessions.
